title: Rhubarb Strawberry and Apple Compote
ingredients: 400g (14oz) rhubarb, washed, trimmed and cut into 1cm pieces
2 large cooking apples (total weight about 400g/14oz), peeled, cored and chopped
method: Place the rhubarb, apples and strawberries into the slow-cooker pot and add the sugar and vanilla.
Mix everything together, place the lid on and cook on high for 1.5 hours, or on low for 3 hours.
When cooked, the fruit should be tender. Use a wooden spoon to break up and blend it all together. Serve hot or cold.
notes: Oven method: 200°C/180°C fan, Gas Mark 6 — medium casserole with lid, bake for 35 minutes, stirring after first 15 minutes. Try with 1/2 teaspoon of ground cinnamon instead of vanilla extract.
